Amar Pardeshi Senior Software Engineer (GCP Certified)

 amarpardeshi05@gmail.com	+91-8275473337   AmarPortfolio	

I am a proactive and achievement-oriented professional with nearly 8 years of experience in Software Development. Proficient in designing, developing, reviewing code and maintaining software applications tailored to meet specific business needs and user requirements.

I have experience in all phases of application lifecycle management, specializing in analysis, development, testing, and implementation of Java-based applications utilizing Spring Boot, Microservices architecture, RESTful API, Open- JFX OAuth2, SQL databases, Team Management and System Design.

Skill full in front-end and back-end development technologies, capable of building responsive user interfaces and robust server-side logic.

Successfully ensured adherence to coding standards, best practices, and quality guidelines throughout the development lifecycle, conducting code reviews, and implementing measures to maintain high code quality, readability, and maintainability

Effectively provided timely resolution to technical issues and bugs reported by users or identified during testing, offering technical support and assistance to end-users to ensure smooth operation and usability of applications

Meritoriously worked with various development frameworks and tools, adept at choosing the right technology stack to optimize application performance and scalability.
